prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — overalls (n.工作服): A pair of sturdy blue work overalls with bib, shoulder straps and full trousers hanging on a hook.
TOP RIGHT — shower (n.淋浴): An empty bathroom shower head sprays water into a tiled shower tray, simple blue water and white tiles.
BOTTOM LEFT — secret (n.秘密): Two adults whisper privately behind a closed door while one holds a sealed envelope close to their chest.
BOTTOM RIGHT — status (n.地位): An organisation chart showing one leader at the top above three staff members, top leader highlighted blue and lower staff grey; simple people symbols with no labels.
